To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

(a) co attention models can be used to generate hierarchical representations of the image or question, (b) these hierarchical representations improve VQA performance, (c) the co attention model does not rely on any external knowledge, and (d) the proposed co attention model can easily be generalized to a wider range of problems, generating hierarchal representations of the image, question and language.

(1) we propose a novel model for VQA which combines attention mechanisms with a novel 1D CNN model to jointly reason about image and question, and (2) we show that the model can be improved by using a 1D CNN to jointly reason about the image and question, as opposed to treating them separately.
